from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import glob, hashlib, numpy as np
t=Path('buehne.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

for n in ['#augen-blink','augen-blink','blink_000.png','style.opacity','_sonderLaeuft','function blink','blinzeln']:

        print('===SRC',key,'POS',i,'===')
        print(t[max(0,i-700):min(len(t),i+2200)])
def stats(path):
    im=Image.open(path).convert('RGBA')
    a=np.asarray(im)[:,:,3]
    nz=a>0; hi=a>=240; mid=a>=128
    ys,xs=np.where(nz) if nz.any() else (np.array([],dtype=int),np.array([],dtype=int))
    bbox=(int(xs.min()),int(ys.min()),int(xs.max())+1,int(ys.max())+1) if len(xs) else None
    return im,a,bbox,float(nz.mean()),float(mid.mean()),float(hi.mean()),float(a.mean()),hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

for p in ['augen_blink/blink_000.png','augen_blink/blink_006.png','augen_gaze/rotglow_tracking_master.png']:
    im,a,bbox,nz,mid,hi,amean,h=stats(p)

paths=sorted(glob.glob('augen_blink/blink_*.png'))
arr=[np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'))[:,:,3] for p in paths]
union=np.maximum.reduce(arr)
ys,xs=np.where(union>0)
ub=(int(xs.min()),int(ys.min()),int(xs.max())+1,int(ys.max())+1)
print('BLINK_COUNT',len(paths),'UNION_BBOX',ub,'UNION_NZ_FRAC',round(float((union>0).mean()),6),'UNION_A240_FRAC',round(float((union>=240).mean()),6))
a0=arr[0]; x0,y0,x1,y1=ub; roi=a0[y0:y1,x0:x1]

expr=sorted(glob.glob('ausdruck_erweitert/*/*/frontal/stufe_*.png'))

sizes={}; valid=0
for p in expr:
    try:
        im=Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'); sizes[im.size]=sizes.get(im.size,0)+1
        if im.width>=x1 and im.height>=y1: valid+=1
    except Exception as e: print('BAD_EXPR',p,repr(e))
print('EXPRESSION_SIZES',sorted((str(k),v) for k,v in sizes.items()))
print('EXPRESSION_CAN_COVER_UNIONROI',valid,'/',len(expr))
for p in expr[:12]:
    im=Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'); a=np.asarray(im)[:,:,3]; r=a[y0:y1,x0:x1] if im.width>=x1 and im.height>=y1 else np.zeros((0,0),dtype=np.uint8)
    print('EXPR_SAMPLE',p,'size',im.size,'roi_alpha_mean',round(float(r.mean()),3) if r.size else None,'roi_opaque_frac',round(float((r>=240).mean()),6) if r.size else None)
